name: Bored API
tagline: Random activity ideas by type and group size
description: Public API that returns random boredom-busting activity suggestions, filterable by type, participants, and cost. Simple unauthenticated GET endpoints for quick inspiration and demo apps.

auth.details: No authentication required; open public endpoints.

use_cases: suggest a random activity when a user is bored
filter activities by type such as education or recreational
get activities for a specific number of participants
prototype a boredom-buster feature without auth setup
